title: readsf~

messages.description: channel output of a given file

arguments.description: per channel buffer size in bytes

flags.name: -m
flags.description: creates a multichannel signal with number of input channels given as the 1st argument

methods.description: sets a filename, an onset in samples, header size to skip, number of channels, bytes per sample, and endianness
sets number of output channels when invoked with the -m flag
prints information on Pd's terminal window

body: [readsf~] plays a soundfile from disk into its signal outputs. Open the file with the 'open' message a couple of seconds before you need it, then start playback with 'start' or a nonzero float.
